name: What is the difference between flat, eggshell, and satin paint finishes?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between flat, eggshell, and satin paint finishes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Flat paint has no sheen and helps hide imperfections but is less washable. Eggshell has a slight sheen, offering more durability and washability than flat. Satin has a noticeable sheen, is very durable, and easy to clean, making it suitable for high-traffic areas. The choice depends on desired appearance and practicality.
acceptedAnswer.description: Flat has no sheen, eggshell has a slight sheen, and satin has a noticeable sheen. Each offers different durability and washability.
